deliverables_scope.text: ===== FILE: files/Att_1_29_Statement_of_Work.pdf ===== STATEMENT OF WORK (SOW) USSOCOM Performance Nutrition Platform 1.0 PURPOSE & OVERALL OBJECTIVE The primary purpose of this contract is to procure commercial Software- as-a- Service (SaaS) licenses for the Teamworks Nutrition platform (formerly known as Notemeal). The platform shall provide a secure, internet -based performance nutrition ecosystem that integrates USSOCOM Performance Dietitians (PDs), Special Operations Forces (SOF) Service Members (SMs), and USSOCOM Food Servic e Systems to optimize human performance and lethality through targeted, accessible nutrition. This system shall serve as an enterprise-wide performance nutrition calibration

n platform (formerly known as Notemeal). It is a globally integrated system serving over 9.6 million beneficiaries, including active-duty service members, retirees, and their families. The MHS is unique in that it functions as both a direct healthcare provider and a multi-billion-dollar health insurance payer through the TRICARE program. Its ultimate success

e medical capabilities, austere mission environments, field hospitals and Forward Operating Bases. DoW’s close relationship with the Department of Veterans Affairs (VA) is paramount. The success of an integrated Federal Electronic Health Record (EHR) is a top national priority. Equally critical is the ability to support the continuum of care across operational and enterprise healthcare environments, ensuring that health information generated during military operations can be captured, exchanged, and made available to support continued care within the enterprise health record.
